plugins.faceIDPermission: midna asks for Face ID before you answer an approval.

plugins.photosPermission: midna sends the photos and videos you pick to your midna.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: midna uses where you are to help with what's around you. Your iPhone tells your midna only when you've moved about half a kilometre, or arrived at or left a place you saved.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: With Always, midna hears about a move or an arrival while the app is closed. It never follows you with GPS, and where you are goes only to your own midna.
